purpose: Record the E6 package and installed-Host checks without treating them as current-head evidence.

package.name: kandev-session-cost-0.5.0.tar.gz
package.note: The archive was the previously verified package for source commit 1eb3bb1f. E6 did not rebuild it.

desktop: retained usage lifecycle passed in a separate run

r7_attempt_note: Playwright retries were disabled. The first desktop retention run had one fixture assertion failure because the wire returned token counts as decimal strings while the fixture expected numbers. The fixture was corrected and the retention test passed in a separate r12 run; r12 was not an automatic retry.
import_coverage: The E6 retained-usage fixture used an empty tokscale report and did not prove a successful source-data import. The separate historical-import smoke covers non-empty imports; current-head verification is recorded in E7.
limitations: Older-Host checks prove archive acceptance and tested upgrade guidance only.
No minimum Kandev version is established.
Original browser and build logs were temporary and are not included in this repository. E6 is therefore historical summary evidence, not independently reproducible log evidence.
